candidate: Source changes in the commit containing this report; final production source frozen before benchmarks.

interpretation.runtime_dense: Three fresh processes per version/size/mode. Compare medians; cold parser/native/JIT setup included.
interpretation.other_cases: One process per version/case except native repeat which has three samples. No statistical tail guarantees.
interpretation.allocated_bytes: Cumulative managed allocations, not retained memory or RSS.
interpretation.retained_after_gc_bytes: Total retained managed heap after each stage, not its incremental allocation.
interpretation.rss: Sampled process RSS can miss brief peaks and includes mapped pages. Watchdog duration includes setup/GC/checksums.
interpretation.failures: Baseline OutOfMemoryException was reported by the program, not a watchdog memory-limit kill.
interpretation.padded_inputs: One million real rows padded with trailing spaces to 1100 bytes each. Not arbitrary dense 1 GiB input.
interpretation.editor_session: Headless core profile; no SDL/GPU, audio, game UI, notes, or postprocessing. Four initialization diagnostics reported; no full preview/export test.

native_repeat.scenario: one VSM repeat row, unlimited mode
native_repeat.measurement_scope: isolated parser with counting-allocator overhead; not whole-app latency
